<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<CustomField xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>RLY_Slack_Linked_By__c</fullName>
    <description>Release Relay: how the Slack member ID was linked. SSO: the Federation ID found in Slack. Email: the Salesforce email found in Slack. Self: the approver linked from Slack. Admin: set by hand. Matching never overwrites a Self or Admin link.</description>
    <label>Slack Linked By</label>
    <required>false</required>
    <trackFeedHistory>false</trackFeedHistory>
    <trackHistory>false</trackHistory>
    <type>Picklist</type>
    <valueSet>
        <restricted>true</restricted>
        <valueSetDefinition>
            <sorted>false</sorted>
            <value>
                <fullName>SSO</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>SSO</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Email</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Email</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Self</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Self</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Admin</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Admin</label>
            </value>
        </valueSetDefinition>
    </valueSet>
</CustomField>
